title: Wayfare Pro Points Earning Table
content:
Pro points under **Driver Earnings and Wayfare Pro** are earned per completed trip, and the number earned depends on when the trip was requested and on the ride option it was requested under. The table is identical at every Wayfare Pro status: Wayfare Pro Blue, Silver, Gold, Platinum, Diamond and Diamond Elite.

## Points per completed trip

| Kind of completed trip | Pro points (every status) |
|---|---|
| Peak trip: requested inside a peak period, in any ride option | 3 |
| Premium trip: requested outside peak periods, in a premium ride option | 2 |
| Standard trip: requested outside peak periods, in a ride option that is not premium | 1 |

## Peak periods

Peak periods are read in the market's local time; each period includes its start time and excludes its end time.

| Day group | Peak periods (every status) |
|---|---|
| Monday to Friday | 06:30 to 09:30, and 16:00 to 19:00 |
| Friday and Saturday nights | 21:00 to 02:00 |

## Premium ride options

Wayfare Black and Wayfare Black SUV are the premium ride options at every status. Every other ride option (Wayfare Shared, Wayfare Standard, Wayfare Green, Wayfare Comfort, Wayfare XL) earns standard points outside peak periods.

## Precedence

A trip that is both a peak trip and a premium trip earns the peak points, 3. Peak and premium points are never added together, so no single trip earns more than 3 points.

## Hypothetical illustrations

| Hypothetical trip | Points |
|---|---|
| Wayfare Standard trip requested on a Tuesday at 07:15 | 3 (peak) |
| Wayfare Black trip requested on a Tuesday at 11:00 | 2 (premium, outside peak) |
| Wayfare Black SUV trip requested on a Wednesday at 17:30 | 3 (peak takes precedence; never 5) |
| Wayfare Comfort trip requested on a Thursday at 09:30 | 1 (09:30 is the excluded end of the morning period) |
| Wayfare XL trip requested on a Monday at 06:30 | 3 (06:30 is the included start of the morning period) |
